required_credentials.use: Planner, Verifier, SCHEDULE Planner/Builder, embeddings; use approved low-cost deployments
Postgres memory plus PostgreSQL/PGVector hybrid RAG
orchestrator inbound webhook and Excel Tools only

ui_configuration: Select both Data Tables in every matching Data Table node.
Apply the seven mandatory MVP Execute Workflow bindings.
Configure Excel Tools base URL/API key; 127.0.0.1 is valid only when n8n runs on the same Windows host.
Edit Math Service Configuration in the Calculation Adapter; its default is http://127.0.0.1:8100/api/v1/math and it uses no credential.
Configure one embedding model/dimension consistently for SCHEDULE ingestion and retrieval.
Use Knowledge Ingestion to load expert-authored keyword_instruction and worked_example text into target_base=schedule_mvp; include schema_catalogue JSON only when deterministic rendering needs it.
Keep every workflow inactive until placeholders and credentials are resolved. Activate only required user-facing entrypoints.
activation_order: Run SCHEDULE Knowledge Ingestion manually and verify expert keyword instructions and worked examples through Hybrid Retrieval.
Smoke-test Excel Agent and the inline .data/.inc path while inactive.
Smoke-test Universal Orchestrator through Execute Workflow, then Form, then authenticated HTTP.
Activate Universal Orchestrator web entrypoints only after all gates pass. Do not activate legacy Excel MAS.
smoke_expectations: start without objective returns a bounded HITL request
Calculation Adapter asks for one or more DEV trajectories plus exactly one surface when they are absent and otherwise posts every DEV as repeated trajectory_files fields in one Math Service request
Excel clarification resumes with the same controlled task and correlated evidence snapshot
CREATE and REVISE stop when an affected keyword lacks an active expert instruction or schema JSON needed for deterministic rendering
Hybrid Retrieval combines lexical, semantic and exact tags with RRF and returns full active parent knowledge blocks
Builder evidence_gap routes through Orchestrator to Excel and resumes Builder; no direct specialist-to-specialist call exists
validated CREATE and preserve-by-default REVISE return ordinary bounded .INC text plus completeness/preservation and diff evidence
redacted traces expose decisions, readiness, gates and tool IDs/hashes without prompts, secrets, binary or raw payloads
stale expected_version or wrong gate_id fails closed
mvp_external_blockers: expert-authored active keyword_instruction and schema JSON for each keyword used by the MVP scenario
corporate n8n 2.30.8 UI round-trip with real credentials, Data Tables and network access to Windows Excel FastAPI
deferred_enterprise_gates: optional real tNavigator integration may be designed later as a separate approved project
security/load/backup/DR acceptance and production trace policy
